answer.overlooked_assumption: The agent assumed the webhook URL stored in the database was the correct Zapier catch hook URL, without verifying that the URL format or stored value matched what Zapier expects for the catch endpoint.
answer.why_it_breaks: The seed script at line 99 stores a test webhook URL (http://localhost:4300/api/webhooks/test) instead of the actual Zapier catch hook URL (https://hooks.zapier.com/hooks/catch/1234567/AbCdEfG). When the admin later sets the webhook URL in workspace settings, the application likely uses the value from the database seed as the default or fallback, or the seed run overwrites the correct URL with the localhost test URL. This means outgoing webhooks are sent to localhost:4300 instead of Zapier's catch endpoint, resulting in 404 responses since there is no server running at that local address to receive them.
